mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive monthly FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with concurrent HOUST and RSAFS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply chain disruptions (INDPRO < 90.0), a decline in industrial production signals reduced output capacity that increases inflationary pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 90.0, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0% for two consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation that triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods with CPIAUCSL above 3.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 600.0 thousand units signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST exceeds 600.0 for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 90.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where INDPRO is below 90.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0% and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.
